{"summary": "Writing skill path audit script", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit active skills for ~/lloyd/... paths naming files that do not exist."""
import os, re, sys, json, collections

SKILLS = os.path.expanduser("~/obsidian/skills")
HOME = os.path.expanduser("~")
CODE_ROOT = os.path.join(HOME, "lloyd")

# Path token: starts with ~ or /home/alansrobotlab then lloyd/ (NOT lloyd-data)
PAT = re.compile(r'(?:~|/home/alansrobotlab)/lloyd/(?=[A-Za-z0-9_.<>*{])([A-Za-z0-9_./<>*{}+\-@#~]*)')

TRAIL = ".,;:!?)]}'\"`→  \t"

def skill_dirs():
    out = []
    for d in sorted(os.listdir(SKILLS)):
        p = os.path.join(SKILLS, d)
        if not os.path.isdir(p):
            continue
        if ".archived" in p.split(os.sep):
            continue
        f = os.path.join(p, "SKILL.md")
        if os.path.isfile(f):
            out.append((d, f))
    return out

rows = []
for name, path in skill_dirs():
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
        lines = fh.read().split("\n")
    for ln, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
        for m in PAT.finditer(line):
            tok = m.group(0)
            body = m.group(1)
            # trim trailing punctuation from the token
            while tok and tok[-1] in TRAIL:
                tok = tok[:-1]
            rows.append({"skill": name, "line": ln, "raw": tok, "body": body,
                         "context": line.strip()})

# classify
def has_ext(body):
    last = body.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]
    if not last:
        return False
    if last.startswith("."):  # dotfile like .gitignore -> no extension
        return False
    return "." in last

def templated(raw):
    return any(c in raw for c in "<{*") or "..." in raw
